Alex: Heads up — noticed a spike in WS chunk timings around 09:10 UTC and a handful of client disconnects. Want to know the canonical place to pull per-chunk timing + disconnect reasons so I can correlate with traces.

Sam: Grafana has the stream_v2 dashboard (link below). For raw logs use Loki with the stream_writer label.
Sam: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/streams/stream_v2?orgId=1 :eyes:

Natalie: For disconnect reasons we usually look at both the app logs and the nginx proxy logs. nginx emits 499/502 patterns in Loki under {app="proxy"}.

Ben: If you want a quick query in Loki try this: ```
{job="stream-writer"} |= "disconnect" | json | unwrap reason | count_over_time(5m)
```
Ben: And for per-chunk timing (ms) from structured app logs: ```
{job="stream-writer"} | json | unwrap chunk_duration_ms | avg_over_time(chunk_duration_ms[1m])
```

Alex: Nice. Is there an existing trace/span convention for WS send/recv so I can join traces?

Natalie: Yes — span name "ws.chunk.send" with tag chunk_index and duration. Traces live in Tempo: https://tempo.redwood.internal/trace/{{trace_id}}

observability-bot: alert: stream_writer_chunk_latency_p95 (severity: page) fired at 2026-02-12T09:11:12Z, value=312ms

Alex: Oof. That alert is noisy for small transient spikes. Can we relax p95 from 300ms -> 500ms but keep p99 strict? Who owns that alert rule?

Sam: I think infra-team owns it. @Ben can you take a look at alert config? If we relax p95 we should add a muted window for deploys and circuit-breaker slope checks.

Ben: I can open a PR. Proposal: p95 threshold 500ms, p99 2s, alert only if sustained for 3/5 minutes. Also add runbook pointer to the dashboard and a playbook step: validate nginx connection counts and check prefix cache hit rate.

Alex: Sounds good. Please CC me. If you want I can drop the Loki queries into the PR description for runbook examples.

Ben: Will do. PR in a bit, tagging @Natalie for runbook wording. :thumbsup:

Natalie: I'll add the trace join steps and nginx query snippet.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: stream-writer v1.12.4 to prod (rollout 100%) at 2026-02-12T09:15:02Z

Alex: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the correlation tables after Ben's PR lands.
